description: Per-wallet buy/sell/volume rollup across your tracked Robinhood Chain wallets. Sourced from rhc_trades DIRECTLY, not from a per-subscriber capture log — on RHC every swap is already recorded, so adding a wallet gives you its full history immediately rather than only from the moment you started tracking it. (The Solana tracker cannot do this: there, trades are only captured for wallets somebody asked for.) stats_unavailable=true means the rollup timed out and the per-wallet stats are zeroed, not absent. Tier: PRO+.

wallet.description: Restrict the rollup to one tracked wallet

name: rhc_wallet_tracker_summary
